page.overview:
Who is Valentin?

Valentin was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Valentin was a smuggler based in Carthag who was part of a group with led by Stisk, which also included Zoe, Chingo and Maax. He entered the Carthag ampitheater and delivered poisoned Spice to the legendary gladiator Argus Veer, whom he had idolised since he was a child. As he travelled through the main concourse, he saw twenty metre holograms of himself and his fellow smugglers. He met with Zoe and Stisk and informed them that alerts seeking them were broadcast on the Communinet Radio stations of both House Harkonnen and the Imperium. Stisk stated that she had it covered, which Valentin dismissed as "bullshit". Stisk insisted that they would escape in ten minutes as the authorities would be to distracted to hunt them, as the crowd would revolt upon learning of Veer's death. Chingo and Maax arrived and informed the others that they had spread the word about Veer's death. Stisk then revealed that she had blown their cover by falsely reporting all of the alcohol in the vault they had hit in Tsimpo as destroyed. Zoe and Valentin were angered that Stisk had made it so they could never return to their homes, as she was willing to sabotage her own people due to her vendetta against the Harkonnens.
